warnings: W_LTC_CMS_CA100: field count mismatch: header=21, parsed=20

tables.note: The manual's field table prints 20 of the 21 fields its header declares, and from row 8 (LIVE_TYPE) down its 備註 (notes) column looks shifted one row too low: GENDER carries the living-arrangement codes, STATUS the sex codes, CLOSE_DT the case-status codes, ABORIGINE the tribe list (which fits RACE_TYPE), ISDISBOOK the indigenous-status codes, DEATH_DT yes/no, and INFORM_CITY_CODE the note on VALID_DATE. Everything is shown as printed; confirm with the Health and Welfare Data Center before relying on these code lists.
tables.note_zh: 手冊欄位表只列出表頭所載 21 個欄位中的 20 個；自第 8 列（LIVE_TYPE）起，備註欄似乎整欄下移一列：GENDER 列的是居住狀況代碼、STATUS 列的是性別代碼、CLOSE_DT 列的是個案狀態代碼、ABORIGINE 列的是族別清單（應屬 RACE_TYPE）、ISDISBOOK 列的是原住民身分代碼、DEATH_DT 列的是有/無、INFORM_CITY_CODE 列的是 VALID_DATE 的說明。本站依手冊原樣呈現，使用前請向衛生福利資料科學中心確認。

tables.note: The manual's field table prints 20 of the 21 fields its header declares, and from row 8 (LIVE_TYPE) down its 備註 (notes) column looks shifted one row too low: GENDER carries the living-arrangement codes, STATUS the sex codes, CLOSE_DT the case-status codes, ABORIGINE the tribe list (which fits RACE_TYPE), ISDISBOOK the indigenous-status codes, DEATH_DT yes/no, and INFORM_CITY_CODE the note on VALID_DATE. Everything is shown as printed; confirm with the Health and Welfare Data Center before relying on these code lists.
tables.note_zh: 手冊欄位表只列出表頭所載 21 個欄位中的 20 個；自第 8 列（LIVE_TYPE）起，備註欄似乎整欄下移一列：GENDER 列的是居住狀況代碼、STATUS 列的是性別代碼、CLOSE_DT 列的是個案狀態代碼、ABORIGINE 列的是族別清單（應屬 RACE_TYPE）、ISDISBOOK 列的是原住民身分代碼、DEATH_DT 列的是有/無、INFORM_CITY_CODE 列的是 VALID_DATE 的說明。本站依手冊原樣呈現，使用前請向衛生福利資料科學中心確認。
